news.title: POWERINDIA: Future Returns Will Be Limited By High P/E Despite Margin Outlook
news.body: Analysts have raised their price target for Hitachi Energy India from ₹18,408.68 to ₹20,300.00, reflecting updated views on the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions. What's in the News Hitachi Energy India and Adani Energy Solutions commissioned a high voltage direct current city center infeed in Mumbai that can inject up to 1,000 megawatts of power directly into the city, targeting power for more than 20 million people (Key Developments).

news.title: POWERINDIA: Future Returns Will Be Constrained By Margin Pressure Despite Revenue Optimism
news.body: Analysts now set their price target for Hitachi Energy India at approximately ₹18,409, a very small change from about ₹18,400. This reflects updated views on revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E assumptions.

news.title: POWERINDIA: New Power Module Partnership Will Support Long Term Upside
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target on Hitachi Energy India from ₹26,600 to ₹28,500, citing updated assumptions on the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E as the key drivers behind the change. What's in the News Hitachi Energy and Pakal Technologies announced a collaboration focused on shared value creation and sustainable growth, centered on integrating Pakal Technologies' Insulated Gate Turn-Off (Thyristor), IGTO(t), silicon power switch into Hitachi Energy's high-voltage power modules portfolio (Key Developments).

news.title: POWERINDIA: Fair Value View Will Depend On Efficiency Gains And Margin Resilience
news.body: Analysts have lifted their fair value estimate for Hitachi Energy India to about ₹23,872 from roughly ₹23,198, citing updated assumptions around revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E multiples. What's in the News Hitachi Energy and Pakal Technologies announced a collaboration focused on shared value creation and sustainable growth, with Pakal's Insulated Gate Turn-Off (Thyristor), IGTO(t), to be used in Hitachi Energy's high-voltage power modules for applications such as rail, renewables, energy storage, AI and data center infrastructure (Key Developments).

news.title: POWERINDIA: Future Returns Will Depend On Margin Pressure And Lower P/E
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target on Hitachi Energy India from ₹17,400 to ₹18,400, citing updated assumptions on discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E, which refine their long term valuation view. What's in the News Hitachi Energy and Pakal Technologies agreed to collaborate on integrating Pakal's Insulated Gate Turn-Off Thyristor, IGTO(t), silicon power switch into high-voltage power modules used in rail, renewables, energy storage, AI and data center infrastructure (Client Announcements).

news.title: POWERINDIA: Fair Value View Will Rely On Sustained Margins And Earnings
news.body: Analysts have lifted their fair value estimate for Hitachi Energy India to ₹23,197.69 from ₹22,232.15, citing slightly lower assumed discount rates, a modestly higher profit margin outlook, and a reduced future P/E multiple as key drivers of the updated price target. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for February 5, 2026, to consider and approve the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹58.65 (vs ₹32.41 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹58.65 (up from ₹32.41 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹21.7b (up 34% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹2.61b (up 90% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 12% (up from 8.5% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 35% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 20% growth forecast for the Electrical industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 79% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 93% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 6.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. This is currently the only risk that has been identified for the company.
